Next week is looking like a mountain, isn’t it? I’ve been there—staring at a blank screen at 2 AM while the coffee stops working and the deadline anxiety kicks in. Most students spend the weekend stressing, but that’s exactly how you end up with a 2:2. 

Here is how we’re flipping the script:

Slide 1: The Trap. Procrastinating until Monday because you’re overwhelmed.
Slide 2: The Blueprint. Break your assignments into 45-minute focus blocks. Don’t write; just outline the arguments first.
Slide 3: The Reality Check. If you’re stuck, don’t spiral. Reach out early. 

Stop waiting for inspiration to strike. It won’t. Structure is the only thing that gets that paper finished. Save this for when the Sunday Scaries hit.

If you’re feeling the pressure for next week, let’s get ahead of it now:

• Map out your word counts by day, not by total.
• Use the 'Rule of Three' for every paragraph to keep your arguments tight.
• Don't wait for 'perfect'—get the draft down, then refine.
